add-actualtext-to-images.title: Add ActualText to Images for PDF Accessibility
add-actualtext-to-images.description: Demonstrates how to attach an ActualText attribute to each image in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged‑content API, enabling screen readers to read alternative text.

add-caption-note-to-figure.title: Add Caption Note to Figure in Tagged PDF
add-caption-note-to-figure.description: Demonstrates how to create a Figure element and attach a Note element as a caption within a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, improving accessibility.

add-custom-cell-tags-and-validate-pdf.title: Add Custom Cell Tags And Validate Pdf

add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.title: Add Custom Tag to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF, add a paragraph element, assign a custom tag name, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-external-link-with-title-to-tagged-p.title: Add External Link with Title to a Tagged PDF
add-external-link-with-title-to-tagged-p.description: Demonstrates how to insert a clickable external URL into a PDF's tagged structure and set its Title attribute for accessibility.

add-internal-link-element-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Internal Link Element To Tagged Pdf

add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Internal Page Link to Tagged PDF
add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a /Link element in a tagged PDF that points to an internal page using Aspose.Pdf's tagged‑content API.

add-missing-language-attributes-to-pdf-s.title: Add Missing Language Attributes To Pdf Structure

add-note-element-to-paragraph.title: Add Note Element to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-note-element-to-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to create a note (footnote/endnote) element and attach it as a child of a paragraph within a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Page Break Element to Tagged PDF
add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a page‑break element into the logical structure tree of a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged‑content API.

add-placeholder-textbox-form-field-tagge.title: Add Placeholder TextBox Form Field with Tagged Structure
add-placeholder-textbox-form-field-tagge.description: Loads an existing PDF, inserts a TextBox form field with placeholder text, creates a /Form logical structure element, links the field to the tagged structure, and saves the updated document.

add-tagged-form-field-with-placeholder.title: Add Tagged Form Field With Placeholder

add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.title: Add TextBox Form Field and Tag It for Accessibility
add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a TextBox form field, register it in the AcroForm, and associate it with a Form structure element to produce a tagged PDF with accessibility information using Aspose.Pdf.

append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.title: Append Paragraph with ActualText to a TOCI Element
append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.description: Demonstrates how to create a TOCI (Table of Contents Item) element in a tagged PDF, add a paragraph child, set its ActualText for screen‑reader accessibility, and save the document.

apply-custom-row-borders-to-pdf-table.title: Apply Custom Row Borders To Pdf Table

batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.title: Batch Convert PDFs to Tagged PDF/A with Auto‑Tagging
batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of untagged PDFs, enable Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging, convert each document to a tagged PDF/A format, and save the results to a separate output directory.

batch-convert-untagged-pdfs-to-tagged.title: Batch Convert Untagged Pdfs To Tagged

batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.title: Batch PDF/A-1B Validation with XML Logs and Compliance Dashboard
batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.description: The example loads all PDF files in a folder, validates each against the PDF/A‑1B standard using Aspose.Pdf, writes XML validation logs, and displays a console dashboard with overall and per‑file compliance percentages.

batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.title: Batch Tag PDFs and Save with Suffix
batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files, enable automatic tagging, add missing structure elements, set language and title, and save each tagged PDF with a custom suffix.

batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.title: Batch Validate PDFs and Generate Summary CSV
batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, validate each against PDF/A‑1B using Aspose.Pdf, write individual XML logs, and produce a consolidated CSV summary of the compliance results.

batch-validate-pdfs-xml-logs-summary-csv.title: Batch Validate Pdfs Xml Logs Summary Csv

check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log-result.title: Check Pdf Ua Compliance And Log Result

check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.title: Check PDF/UA Compliance and Log Result
check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, checking its PDF/UA accessibility compliance, and appending the boolean outcome to a log file for further processing.

convert-pdf-to-pdf-ua-with-auto-tagging.title: Convert Pdf To Pdf Ua With Auto Tagging

create-merged-table-header-tagged-pdf.title: Create Merged Table Header Tagged Pdf

create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.title: Create Nested Bullet and Numbered Lists in a Tagged PDF
create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF containing a top‑level bullet list and a numbered list with a nested bullet sub‑list using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API for accessibility.

create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.title: Create PDF with Heading Element and Language Attribute
create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF, enable tagged content, set the document language, add a level‑1 heading element with its own language attribute, and save the file.

create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.title: Create Tagged 3x4 Table in PDF
create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's Tagged Content API to add a 3‑row by 4‑column table with alternative text to the structure tree of an existing PDF and save the result.

create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.title: Create Tagged PDF Table with Merged Header Cells
create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.description: Demonstrates how to tag a PDF table, add a header row with merged cells, assign the TH role, and set ActualText for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.title: Create Tagged PDF with Table of Contents
create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, add tagged headings, configure a dedicated Table of Contents page, and build the logical TOC structure for accessibility.

create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.title: Create Tagged Table with Custom DataType Tags and Validate PDF/A-1B
create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.description: The example loads a PDF, builds a tagged table structure, assigns custom data‑type tags to individual cells, saves the document, and validates it for PDF/A‑1B compliance.

custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.title: Custom Table Cell Borders by Row Index
custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and apply different background colors (as a visual cue for border styling) to cells based on the row index, demonstrating custom border appearance.

enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.title: Enable Automatic Tagging and Save PDF as Tagged PDF
enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to activate Aspose.Pdf's auto‑tagging feature, set basic language and title metadata, and save the document as a PDF/UA‑compliant tagged PDF.

export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to JSON
export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read its tagged logical structure with Aspose.Pdf, convert the hierarchy into a serializable DTO, and write the structure tree as a formatted JSON file for accessibility analysis.

export-pdf-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-rep.title: Export Pdf Structure Tree To Xml Xsl Report

export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to XML and Generate Report via XSLT
export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, exports its logical structure tree to an XML file using XmlSaveOptions, and then applies an XSLT stylesheet to produce an HTML report.

export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.title: Export Tagged PDF Content to JSON
export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.description: Shows how to read a PDF's tagged structure with Aspose.Pdf, build a hierarchical representation, and serialize it to a JSON file.

extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.title: Extract Notes from Tagged PDF to Text File
extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, accesses its tagged content, finds all NoteElement objects, concatenates their ActualText, and writes the combined notes to a plain text file.

extract-pdf-links-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Links to CSV
extract-pdf-links-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages and link annotations, extract the target URLs, and write them to a CSV file.

extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.title: Extract Text from Tagged PDF Structure Tree
extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, access its tagged content, and recursively traverse the logical structure tree to extract the actual text of each element.

filter-xml-missing-alt-text.title: Filter XML Errors for Missing Alt Text
filter-xml-missing-alt-text.description: Shows how to load an XML validation report, query for errors of type "MissingAltText", and output the affected image IDs.

iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.title: Iterate Tagged PDF Structure Elements and Log Titles & Languages
iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.description: The example loads a PDF, accesses its tagged content, and recursively walks the logical structure tree, outputting each element's title and language. It also notes the limitation of retrieving custom tags via the Aspose.PDF API.

modify-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.title: Modify Paragraph Actualtext In Tagged Pdf

nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.title: Create Nested Table Inside Paragraph in Tagged PDF
nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to build a paragraph element, add an outer table, embed a nested table within a cell, set alternative text, and validate the tagging hierarchy using Aspose.Pdf's Tagged PDF API.

propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.title: Propagate Language Attribute to All Tagged PDF Elements
propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.description: Demonstrates how to set a document‑level language and automatically propagate it to every structure element in a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.title: Replace Note Element in Tagged PDF
replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to locate an existing Note element in a tagged PDF, remove it, and insert an updated Note with new text using Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API.

replace-note-elements-in-tagged-pdf.title: Replace Note Elements In Tagged Pdf

set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.title: Set ActualText on a Span for Pronunciation in Tagged PDF
set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.description: Shows how to create a span element in a tagged PDF, assign visible text, and provide hidden pronunciation text via the ActualText property.

set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Figure Title in Tagged PDF
set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to create a figure element in a tagged PDF, assign a Title and AlternativeText for accessibility, and append it to the structure tree before saving.

set-missing-language-attributes.title: Set Missing Language Attributes in Tagged PDF
set-missing-language-attributes.description: Loads a PDF, accesses its tagged structure, and recursively assigns a default language to any structure element that lacks a language attribute, then saves the updated document.

set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Paragraph Title in Tagged PDF for Accessibility
set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TaggedContent API to create a paragraph element, assign a Title property for accessibility, and save the updated PDF.

set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.title: Set Primary Language for a Tagged PDF
set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a language attribute to the structure tree of a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring the document is marked with its primary content language.

set-root-structure-element-title.title: Set Root Structure Element Title in Tagged PDF
set-root-structure-element-title.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, access its tagged content, retrieve the root structure element, assign a document title, and save the updated file.

style-table-cells-background-border-padd.title: Style Table Cells with Background Color, Border, and Padding
style-table-cells-background-border-padd.description: Shows how to apply background colors, border thickness/color, and padding to individual table cells in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

summarize-pdf-validation-errors.title: Summarize PDF Validation Report Errors
summarize-pdf-validation-errors.description: Loads an Aspose.Pdf validation XML report, aggregates error codes and messages, and outputs a summary of error frequencies and the top error messages.

update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.title: Update Paragraph ActualText in Tagged PDF
update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating a paragraph element by its title via the structure tree, and modifying its ActualText property for accessibility corrections.

update-tagged-element-language-french.title: Update Language of a Tagged PDF Structure Element to French
update-tagged-element-language-french.description: Shows how to set the document's default language and modify the language property of a specific tagged structure element in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-ua-compliance-export-xml.title: Validate PDF/UA Compliance and Export XML Structure
validate-pdf-ua-compliance-export-xml.description: Demonstrates how to validate a tagged PDF against PDF/UA standards using Aspose.Pdf, write a validation log, and export the document's logical structure as an XML report.

validate-pdf-ua-compliance-xml-report.title: Validate Pdf Ua Compliance Xml Report
